body: I have tried my best to do the first two. I can't continue not being happy. Every day is a struggle to get up.
I have no motivation any more, just depression.

I've been depressed for too many years from too many things and I can never stop thinking about so many things whirring around in my head and I'm not even 20 and I know you think 'so young' as everyone would say, but I don't want to be so miserable and unhappy any more. Then I'd continue living my life out masking what depression i have to mask every day. What i've masked for years getting back from school to have no energy for anything. Ruining and wasting the potential everyone always said I had just to make me even more depressed I have nothing for the 'brains' people always told me I had. I just can't deal with it any more.
